C1.name: HomePageGUI
responsibilities: application entry point (main) that shows the home page and opens the registration and login windows

C2.name: UserLoginGUI
responsibilities: collects login credentials and hands them to UserLoginController

C3.name: UserRegistrationGUI
responsibilities: collects registration data and submits it through SystemServicesController

C4.name: UserDashboardGUI
responsibilities: role-dependent dashboard that opens the report creation, review and monitoring windows

C5.name: ReportCreationGUI
responsibilities: form where a citizen creates a report

C6.name: SubmittedReportsGUI
responsibilities: lists the reports a citizen submitted and shows their details

C7.name: ReceivedReportsGUI
responsibilities: lists the received reports for an operator, with filters, and opens the note and status-update windows

C8.name: ReportStatusUpdateGUI
responsibilities: lets an operator advance the status of a report

C9.name: InternalNoteGUI
responsibilities: lets an operator add an internal note to a report

C10.name: ActivityMonitoringGUI
responsibilities: lets an operator request activity-trend monitoring results

C11.name: SystemServicesController
responsibilities: facade giving the boundary one entry point; delegates each use case to its use-case controller

C12.name: UserLoginController
responsibilities: validates login data and obtains the user session data from UserService

C13.name: UserRegistrationController
responsibilities: validates registration data and rejects an already registered email before registering the user

C14.name: ReportCreationController
responsibilities: validates report data, checks the user is a citizen and requests report registration

C15.name: ReportReviewController
responsibilities: checks the user role and retrieves submitted (citizen) or received (operator) reports

C16.name: ReportDetailsController
responsibilities: checks access to a report (operator or owning citizen) and retrieves its details and history

C17.name: ReportStatusUpdateController
responsibilities: checks operator privileges, advances the report status and then requests the notification

C18.name: InternalNoteController
responsibilities: checks operator permission and requests registration of an internal note

C19.name: ActivityMonitoringController
responsibilities: authorises the operator, validates criteria and requests monitoring results

C20.name: NotificationController
responsibilities: decides whether a status is notifiable and requests the citizen notification

C21.name: ReportService
responsibilities: domain service for reports: registers reports, retrieves them, updates status, adds notes, generates notifications and monitoring statistics

C22.name: UserService
responsibilities: domain service for users: registers users, looks up credentials and checks citizen/operator roles

C23.name: Report
responsibilities: persistent report: data, location, assigned operator, internal notes, status updates and a status object that drives status changes

C24.name: User
responsibilities: abstract persistent user with name, phone number and credentials (single-table inheritance)

C25.name: Citizen
responsibilities: user who submits reports

C26.name: MunicipalOperator
responsibilities: user who reviews, updates and annotates reports

C27.name: InternalNote
responsibilities: persistent internal note written by an operator on a report

C28.name: StatusUpdate
responsibilities: persistent record of a status change made by an operator

C29.name: Notification
responsibilities: persistent notification sent to a citizen about a report status change

C30.name: ReportCategory
responsibilities: enumerates the categories a report can have

C31.name: ReportStatus
responsibilities: state interface: advances a report and tells whether the status is notifiable

C32.name: Submitted
responsibilities: initial state; advancing makes the report Assigned

C33.name: Assigned
responsibilities: state; advancing makes the report InProgress; notifiable

C34.name: InProgress
responsibilities: state; advancing makes the report Resolved

C35.name: Resolved
responsibilities: final state; refuses further advancement; notifiable

C36.name: PersistenceService
responsibilities: generic persistence operations (save, update, findById, findByAttribute, findByFields) run in transactions

C37.name: JpaUtil
responsibilities: singleton that owns the EntityManagerFactory of the persistence unit and creates EntityManagers

C38.name: reports_db
responsibilities: MySQL database that stores users, reports, internal notes, status updates and notifications
